moves.name: Seated breathing
moves.how: Sit tall on a cushion or chair. Breathe in through your nose, then out slowly through your mouth.

moves.name: Neck and shoulder rolls
moves.how: Drop one ear towards your shoulder, then the other. Roll your shoulders slowly back a few times.

moves.name: Cat–cow stretch
moves.how: On hands and knees. Breathe in and let your back dip gently; breathe out and round it up.

moves.name: Seated side stretch
moves.how: Sit cross-legged. Raise one arm and lean gently to the other side. Switch sides halfway.

moves.name: Hip circles
moves.how: Stand with your feet apart and hands on your hips. Circle your hips slowly one way, then the other.

moves.name: Wall push-ups
moves.how: Stand an arm's length from a wall with your hands on it. Bend your elbows to lean in, then push back.

moves.name: Ankle circles
moves.how: Sitting, lift one foot a little and circle the ankle slowly. Switch feet halfway.

moves.name: Resting breath
moves.how: Sit, or lie on your side with a pillow. Let your breath slow down and your shoulders soften.

moves.name: Find the muscles
moves.how: Sit comfortably. Gently squeeze the muscles you'd use to hold in wind, then let go. Keep breathing.

moves.name: Ten slow holds
moves.how: Squeeze and hold for a slow count of five, then relax for five. Ten times.

moves.name: Quick squeezes
moves.how: Squeeze and let go quickly, ten times, then rest.
